title: E-QTM-0094: the Ehrenfest theorem on the coined Dirac walk model: a positive-band packet follows the classical...
purpose: Experiment E-QTM-0094 in the quantum arena: the Ehrenfest theorem on the coined Dirac walk model: a positive-band packet follows the classical trajectory of its own momentum distribution to a thousandth of a cell over sixty cells free and under a slow force once the Berry-connection shift is included, the momentum half exact, while a fast force drives Landau-Zener leakage into the other band and a mixed-band rest seed lags the classical path by twenty cells.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
